title: Security Impact of the Simon Key Schedule
summary: The paper’s multi-round analyses assume independent round keys, leaving unresolved how Simon’s actual key schedule affects cipher security.

formal_statement.body: Determine how the Simon key schedule affects the security of the Simon block cipher when the cipher's actual, schedule-generated round keys are used, rather than assuming independent round keys in multi-round security analyses.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of the Simon block cipher and its key schedule.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security effect of using round keys generated by Simon’s actual key schedule in multi-round analyses.

citations.label: Observations on the SIMON Block Cipher Family

progress.summary: The source states that the Simon key schedule was outside its investigation and explicitly leaves its influence on security as an important open question. Its multi-round analyses implicitly assume independent round keys.
citation_labels: Stefan Kölbl et al., Observations on the SIMON Block Cipher Family
